profile.headline: SR. Software Developer In Automation at Covance
profile.summary:
A highly skilled Java and Big Data Hadoop software engineer with distinction as a leader-contributor in delivering and supporting business software and analytic solutions. Skilled as a Data Analyst supporting enterprise data insights. Strong self-starter with valuable experience with full life cycle, iterative, SDLC development for new and pre-existing Java and Hadoop based enterprise level web service and data engineering applications. Strong in Devops, testing and support of software solutions. Commitment to innovation, team building, solid communication skills, experienced in complex problem solving, support, data analysis, release management, and a passion for collaborative IT development, resulting in vital roles on many successful software projects.

I am actively looking for my next great employment opportunity.

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
- Conduct detailed analysis, develops and supports software applications designed to provide data sets that support advanced analytic teams. Java, PySpark, Scala, SQL, Hadoop, HDFS.
- Patient Density Analytics Microservice development and support. A hospital data consumption approach to acquire country level healthcare/pharmacy data used to enhance clinical trial execution. Data service gathering drug, drug usage, geo location, patient level data supporting trial feasibility, recruitment, patient drug treatment projections, and analytics.
- Conducts data analysis for insights, usage patterns, data movement, mapping and quality of data availability. Analyzed country-level non-relational data sets for table linkage to enterprise data solutions.  Created logging solutions supporting trial validation.
- Full test suite definition requiring validation prior to merge to development branch and production release.
- Tier-3/4 level Devops production support for all software solutions.

positions.title: Web Application Development Specialist
positions.description:
- Enhanced customer-facing, mission critical web applications used by 5,000 Customer Advocates processing claims and investigations. Reduced claim processing times by 10% through data aggregation of four membership systems. Technologies used are Java, Spring, JSP.
- Developed new features for existing high-performance SOAP Web Services supporting mission critical, high availability applications. Critical to processing over 800,000 claims daily and serving 10k membership customers. Technologies used are Java, SOAP, Spring framework.
- Software release lead / engineering SME. Drove team code base production release readiness/management, primary interface to corporate change board, led regulatory solution auditing. Led full life cycle of delivery from design to wireframe to release. Reduced production errors by 15% increasing overall solution quality and customer satisfaction scores.
- IT SME on load and performance related software enhancements for SOAP web services. Responsible for coordinating multiple development teams, performance tests & tuning web services to ensure high performance and high availability while meeting business SLAs.
- Engineering requirements definition lead. Conducted detailed analysis of data and workflow aligning business processes to software solution capabilities positively enhanced team delivery.
- Tier-3 Production support and troubleshooting for high availability enterprise web services.
